newsitem.title: UK: Vickers drops after in-line results.
newsitem.headline: Vickers drops after in-line results.

text.p: Shares in Vickers Plc dropped sharply on Wednesday after the Challenger tank and Rolls-Royce cars group posted profits no better than analyst expectations, dealers said.
"The figures were just a bit lacklustre and the dividend left a bit to be desired," said one dealer.
The stock was down 17-1/2p to 243-1/2 by 1228 GMT, a low for the year, in volume 2.5 million shares.
Dealers said analysts at SBC Warburg repeated a "hold" rating on the stock, while warning that the company's cautious statement might be the cue for some short-term weakness in the stock.
Analysts at Warburg were not immediately available for comment.

Pre-tax profit rose 11 percent to 83.3 million stg, compared with forecasts mostly between 82 million stg and 85 million, while the dividend was raised to 7.2p, versus expectations between 7.0p and 7.5p.
Vickers said it was "unusually difficult" to foresee the trend of sales and profits in 1997 because of the effects on export orders and earnings of the rise in sterling which began last autumn.
However, it said a better performance should be achieved on a two-year view on the back of the company's investment programme.
